meta.name: Mrs Deshpande
meta.description:
Behind a mask of beauty lies a darkness she's ready to unleash.

Complete series. On your server: S1 6/6

videos.title: Takes One to Catch One
videos.overview: Bollywood star Virat Malhotra is murdered using the same MO as a serial killer from 25 years ago. Commissioner Khatri enlists the help of an unexpected ally to catch the copycat.

videos.title: The Secret Letters
videos.overview: Mrs. Deshpande helps catch a suspect after finding a clue in their exchanged letters. But the suspect makes an unusual request.

videos.title: Truth in the Woods
videos.overview: After a new murder, a special task force is formed. Mrs. Deshpande demonstrates her killing method to Tejas, but she has a daring scheme up her sleeve.

videos.title: A Killer is Born
videos.overview: An old body found in a well draws the cops back to Mrs. Deshpande. Her heart-wrenching story leads to a new suspect.

videos.title: Shishya
videos.overview: As Alex eagerly awaits a reunion with his mother, the copycat claims another victim. Mrs. Deshpande baits the copycat, which leads to dangerously intimate territory.

videos.title: The Final Judgement
videos.overview: When the killer approaches a new target, Mrs. Deshpande negotiates a risky hostage exchange. As shocking truths emerge, a long-awaited justice is delivered.
